messages:
jamie: Quick ping — we need a plan for auth telemetry sampling so console dashboards don't explode but still show per-project attribution.
leah: Current flow tags events with the raw header key_id pre-proxy. Good for key counts, bad for delegated SA visibility.
mario: Customers using proxy+impersonation all show under proxy key. Can't tell which project burned quota.
jamie: Billing/enforcement must remain authoritative (post-exchange). This is only for observability.
sam: Proposal: reservoir sampler per key_id: keep first M events/day, then uniform sample R% after. Also store a compact mapping of hashed effective_identity for hot keys.
leah: That reduces cardinality growth. Implementation: use fixed-size reservoir in the ingest producer, emit sample flag and small eff_id_hash.
mario: Must capture routing metadata too: routed_model, region, fallback_reason — otherwise SLO debugging is useless.
jamie: UX: don't add more dropdowns. Add a small badge on model-route pages "sampled auth events: X/day" linking to pre-filtered logs.
sam: Also add a console toggle: "Include delegated identity in metrics (may increase cost)" default off.
leah: Rollout idea: stage 1 (staging) — sampler + basic eff_id_hash for top 10k keys. stage 2 — expand reservoir, add retention policy.
mario: Retention options? 30d default, 90d for keys tagged billing-discrepancy. Need signoff from billing.
ops-bot: deploy started: telemetry-reservoir@staging -> 0.1.0 by ci/cd at 2026-03-22T18:12:01Z
jamie: Action items: leah prototype reservoir + eff_id_index (PR by EOD Fri), sam mock console badge+toggle copy, mario draft rollout + cost delta, jamie to sync billing on retention.
leah: Note: sampled events must never feed enforcement/quotas. Add an assert in the path to prevent accidental switch.
sam: I'll add tooltip text: "Console metrics are sampled; billing uses authoritative counters." That should reduce support noise.
mario: Sounds good. Let's keep sampling low (<1%) for high-throughput keys, but ensure at-least-N/day for rare keys so their owners see activity.
jamie: Thanks team — looks actionable. Please drop PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
